First Long Island Investors Llc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $772.05B market cap company. The stock increased 6.83% or $6.43 during the last trading session, reaching $100.56. About 13,225 shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 30.43% since December 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 30.43% the S&P500.
